ActorFrame.InitCommand: %function(self) local ThemeNameTable = THEME:GetThemeNames() for ind, TName in ipairs(ThemeNameTable) do if TName == 'OITGThemerFallback' then return end end OITGThemerFallbackNotDetected = true end

Layer.OnCommand: %function(self) if GAMESTATE:GetCoinMode() ~= 2 then self:hidden(0) else self:hidden(1) end self:queuecommand('Thing') end
%function(self) if GAMESTATE:GetCoinMode() == 2 then self:hidden(0) else self:hidden(1) end self:queuecommand('Thing') end
%function(self) if GAMESTATE:GetCoinMode() == 2 and GAMESTATE:GetPremium() == 1 then self:hidden(0) else self:hidden(1) end self:queuecommand('Thing') end
